notes.title: Save on new rogue-like Reignbreaker with our latest bundle!

notes.title: ❄️ Winter Holiday Colouring Contest! ❄️
notes.notes:
❄️ Happy festive holidays, friends! ❄️

Finally, the winter holidays are here. And could there be a better way to celebrate this festivity than having a creative contest? Spoiler: Of course not!

So, it's time for you to show us your artist and colouring expertise! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41486220/fbe3cbc9583f7ba4779c94e1a5a07a9aead98a7e.png[/img]

We will select five winners on the 21st of December. Those five lucky ones will receive Steam keys each for Swordship, Tinkertown, Togges and Wavetale. So you definitely won't be bored over the holidays!

[u][b]How to participate:[/b][/u]
[list][*]Download the image, and you're ready to go. Do whatever you want! You have the freedom to add your unique flair or additions. 🖌️ 
[*]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/thunderful]Discord[/url] server and upload your image in the #tfwintercontest channel or use the same hashtag on Twitter for your chance to win!![/list]
The contest ends on the 21st of December at 15.00 CET, and the winners will be presented on Discord and our Social Media channels.

Terms and Conditions: [url=https://thunderfulgames.com/privacy-policy/]https://thunderfulgames.com/privacy-policy/[/url]

We hope you have a wonderful winter holiday! ❄️

Happy creative colouring everyone!
The Thunderful Community Team

notes.title: Grab Your Net and Waterproof Shoes: Wavetale is Out Now! 🌊
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687583/effcea6123c9f8a9f563829669b7563a238eed3e.jpg[/img]

Ahoy friends!

Grab your net and jump into Sigrid's (waterproof) shoes because [b]Wavetale[/b] finally made its way to Steam! Surf the open waters of a submerged city, unravel the past, fight mysterious sea monsters and discover secrets hidden under the surface...

We are really happy to announce that [b]Wavetale[/b] has NOW landed in Steam waters more than a year after its initial release on Google Stadia. [b]Wavetale[/b] is a project of the heart for us and that's why it means a lot to us that you can now all experience Sigrid's adventures on your preferred platforms:

[previewyoutube=XUvA4vchRms;full][TRAILER][/previewyoutube]
Thanks to all of you out there for playing the [b]Wavetale[/b] demo, giving feedback and joining us on the watery road to the Steam release! Hopefully you'll have as much fun speeding through the open sea as we had developing the game. ❤️

Happy Wavetale release day to all of you!
The Wavetale Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823930/Wavetale/

notes.title: Surf a magical archipelago in Wavetale, a former Stadia exclusive coming to Steam
notes.notes: Thunderful Development's former Stadia exclusive Wavetale hits Steam this week, bringing its island-hopping story to the broader world just before Stadia's demise. Wavetale tells the story of Sigrid, aided by her wave-surfing shadow, on a quest to save a magical and ruined archipelago from its own past... Read more.

notes.notes:

Aye friends!

Once again, it's about time for the fabulous [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! Until October 10th hundreds of demos are live here on Steam, connected to hundreds of streams, developer specials, and much more. Exciting times for sure and you definitely don't want to miss this!

And you guessed it already: [b]Wavetale[/b] is aboard for Steam Next Fest in October as well! Just scroll down the product page and click the "Download" button to get your hands on the demo! Get in the waterproof (demo) shoes of Sigrid, a young girl who befriends a mysterious shadow that provides her with the power to walk on water. Speed through the waves, swing yourself from housetops with your net, and defeat an old nemesis to save the citizens of the islands.

We hope you enjoy playing our demo! If you're having a good time, do us a favor and click on "Follow" as well as on "Add To Your Wishlist" and leave your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1823930]Steam Community Hub[/url]. That would really help us a lot. ❤️

And as you are trying some demos already, check out the additional three titles from Thunderful that are also part of Steam Next Fest: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1898290/LEGO_Bricktales/]LEGO® Bricktales[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550270/Togges/]Togges[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004370/Paper_Cut_Mansion/]Paper Cut Mansion[/url]. notes.title: gamescom is back: Play Wavetale in Cologne and here on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687583/9d8c844c901acf00e21b8171163d9ccdd2260ca4.jpg[/img]

[b]gamescom is back![/b] ːsteamhappyː

After two years without gamescom taking place in Cologne, the world's largest computer and video games event is finally back in 2022, and that has to be celebrated! So, join us at Thunderful Publishing booth in Hall 8.1 B-021 if you want to get your hands on the demo of [b]Wavetale[/b]!

Get in the (waterproof) shoes of Sigrid, a young girl who befriends a mysterious shadow that provides her with the power to walk on water. Speed through the waves, swing yourself from housetops with your net, and defeat an old nemesis to save the citizens of the islands. All with a bit of help from the shadows down below—and your cranky grandmother.

And for all of you who can't come to gamescom in Cologne, we'll bring gamescom to you: The demo is not only playable at gamescom, but also here on Steam.

If you like the demo please follow [b]Wavetale[/b] here on Steam to be the first to know about all our upcoming announcements. And of course, if you’re excited about the game, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist! ❤️

Happy gamescom to all of you!
The Wavetale Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823930/Wavetale/
